name: redact
description: Lets Claude use your API keys, tokens, passwords and email addresses, hiding the ones its patterns match from the model. They are swapped for stable placeholders (API_KEY_1, EMAIL_1) in everything sent to the model, kept in a local vault, and restored in tool calls and your terminal. Fails closed. Pattern-based; add your own with /redact.

patterns.title: Extra patterns
patterns.description: Pattern lines in the patterns file's format, masked after its patterns (the built-in rules among them): each match whole, or its v group (a lookbehind keeps a prefix), labelled by label= or the first other named group, SECRET without one. A list, so set it in settings.json pluginConfigs: /config does not show list fields
